excluded_workflow.title: lean.yml
excluded_workflow.content:
name: Lean
on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      - light-eft-spanners-checkpoints
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: paper-formalizations-single-compiler
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    if: github.ref != 'refs/heads/light-eft-spanners-checkpoints'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Full sequential kernel replay grows with the all-papers library.
    # Keep every replay; the preceding 30-minute ceiling interrupted clean progress.
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@a1e4f67744f24ab80ec3c7ab1bd37d7d419207d5
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "true"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          mk_all-check: "false"
          axiom-audit: "true"
          axiom-audit-root: "VFTSpanners"
          axiom-audit-allow: "propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound"
      - name: Strictly verify actual stored-edge sample construction and voting
        run: |
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredEdgeMembership.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredRecordEncoding.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredRecordExecutable.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredRecordMachine.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredRecordTrace.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredSampleEncoding.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredSampleEntry.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredVoteBound.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredVoteEncoding.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredVoteExecutable.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredVoteMachine.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredVoteTrace.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredRecordSmoke.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredVoteSmoke.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredVoteSafetyAudit.lean"
      - name: Strictly verify stored host and candidate traversal
        run: |
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredHostAdmission.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredHostBound.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredHostCount.lean"

          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredHostRealAdmission.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredHostTrace.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredCandidateBound.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredCandidateExecutable.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredCandidateMachine.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredCandidateOriginal.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredCandidateRefinement.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredCandidateTrace.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredHostSmoke.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredHostSafetyAudit.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredCandidateSmoke.lean"

          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredAssignmentSmoke.lean"

          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredGreedyGuarantee.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredOutputLaw.lean"

      - name: Strictly verify incidence preparation and same-record host voting

      - name: Strictly verify actual candidate preparation and same-bank execution

          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredCandidateBankPreparation.lean"

          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredCandidatePreparationEncoding.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredPreparedCandidateAssignment.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredPreparedCandidateBound.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredPreparedCandidateExecutable.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredPreparedCandidateOriginal.lean"

          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/ComponentPreparationSmoke.lean"
